Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=capacity-controller env=prod-west-1 — queue backlog > 95th percentile and autoscaler not adding nodes. Pager: PD-INC-4821
PagerDuty: Pager triggered — primary: Maya (oncall). Escalation policy: autoscaler-oncall -> infra-team.
Maya (oncall): acked. I'm on it, pulling logs and metrics.
Maya (oncall): quick status — are we seeing node provisioning errors or just slow launches?
Incident Bot: Autoscaler event stream snapshot:
```
[2026-03-15T12:41:02Z] scale_request: desired_nodes=120 current_nodes=60 reason=queue_surge
[2026-03-15T12:41:05Z] provision_attempt node_type=gpu-v100 region=prod-west-1 status=FAILED error=QuotaExceeded
[2026-03-15T12:42:10Z] provision_attempt node_type=gpu-v100 region=prod-west-1 status=FAILED error=RateLimit:API
[2026-03-15T12:44:30Z] backlog_size=18750 avg_latency=820ms p95_latency=1400ms
```
Jamal (sre): looks like provider returns quota + transient API throttles. autoscaler retries but backoff and cluster limits prevent fast catch-up.
Liam (infra): confirmed in cloud console — GPU quota for prod-west-1 exhausted for our project. Requests are failing with 403 QuotaExceeded. Also seeing slow allocation due to provider control-plane errors.
Maya (oncall): customer impact? latency/timeouts? Sofia?
Sofia (customer-success): monitoring shows ~12k active requests with 6% error rate on streaming endpoints for a subset of customers in EU/APAC routed through prod-west-1. Some paying customers seeing degraded realtime response; support tickets trickling in.
Alex (eng-runtime): we have two levers: 1) divert new requests to the dedicated pool in us-east-1 (capacity-reserve-1), 2) scale up smaller CPU-only runners with model-quantized q4 to accept degraded-quality but keep latency bound. Which is faster?
Jamal (sre): diverting traffic requires changing routing policy + warm-up of model runners but should be < 5m if we flip the routing override. Spinning up smaller runners may take ~6-10m depending on image pull. Provider quota still needed for any new nodes in prod-west-1.
Maya (oncall): flipping routing to dedicated pool now. I'll also start a manual scale to smaller runners as fallback.
Maya (oncall): @opsbot run command to update routing policy to prefer capacity-reserve-1 for prod-west-1 overflow
Incident Bot: Command received: updating smart-routing policy.
Maya (oncall): manual scale commands (run by Jamal with elevated perms)
Jamal (sre): executing manual scale for quantized-runner service:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/quantized-runner
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/quantized-runner --replicas=40
# autoscaler: override disabled to prevent immediate downscale
redwoodctl autoscale override --service quantized-runner --min 40 --ttl 1800
```
Jamal (sre): scale command accepted, new pods entering Pending due to image pull; catching provider quota 403 on some attempts but enough succeeded to get ~28 pods ready so far.
Liam (infra): meanwhile I've opened an emergency quota request with cloud console (case #CLOUD-9982). Also queuing a cross-project borrow of spare capacity from our shared infra for immediate relief.
Sofia (customer-success): I sent an email to top-10 affected customers, letting them know we're mitigating and tracking SLA impact.
Alex (eng-runtime): to reduce token cost and cpu, I'm enabling prefix KVCACHE on high-volume routes to reduce pressure on inference nodes. Patch in prod in 2 minutes.
Maya (oncall): status update: routing override applied, traffic delta shows ~55% of new requests routed to capacity-reserve-1. p95 latency dropped from 1400ms -> 650ms for routed traffic. Overall error rate down from 6% -> 1.8%.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Maya (oncall). Escalation to infra (Liam) in progress.
Liam (infra): temporary borrow succeeded, added 24 nodes from shared-infra pool into prod-west-1 under tag=emergency. Autoscaler now reports desired=120 current=110. Backlog trending down.
Jamal (sre): watching logs; no further QuotaExceeded errors after borrow, but provider API rate-limit spikes remain fine-grained; we'll keep retry jitter.
Maya (oncall): customer impact — Sofía can we get an updated count and a note for legal/ops?
Sofia (customer-success): updated ticket: ~350 affected sessions from paying customers, partial degradation, no data loss. Escalated for priority follow-up. I'll add a postmortem note linking support tickets.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Liam for infra remediation and quota follow-through. I'll stay on until stabilization.
Liam (infra): I'll coordinate with cloud account team for permanent quota increase and schedule regional redistribution. Adding runbook steps in incident doc.
Alex (eng-runtime): follow-up items: 1) add cross-region automatic fallback earlier in scaling path, 2) improve autoscaler backoff behavior when provider returns QuotaExceeded, 3) add synthetic tests for provider quota exhaustion. I'll create JIRA tickets.
Maya (oncall): thanks team. Summary saved to #incidents and I've linked the runbook + PD alert. Marking this thread resolved for oncall; leaving open for infra until quota case closed. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty incident PD-INC-4821 status=acknowledged resolved_by=Maya (oncall) note="routing override + shared-infra borrow applied"
PagerDuty: PD-INC-4821 -> status: acknowledged -> resolved (awaiting postmortem).
Maya (oncall): closing thread here, will ping when quota is permanent. Good job everyone. :pray:
